Good size: one primary workflow, a few state authorities, roughly 5-20 primary production files/symbol clusters, relevant tests and immediate dependencies. Risk: critical/high/normal/low; mappers must not report findings.

Setting up the plan and launching bounded discovery workers.Frame confirmed: 17 packages, ~54k LOC production Go, clear state-file families. **Map summary — 16 candidate surfaces across 6 domains, 9 seams:**

| Domain | Surfaces | Risk |
|---|---|---|
| R · Run-control & product-state SQLite | run-lifecycle-fencing; recovery-migration-retention; product-state dual-home seam | critical, high, high |
| S · Study state | runloop-scheduler-state; dual-home checkpoint parity; session checkpointing/stores | critical, high, normal |
| F · Sprint flow/execute | flow-stage-machine-publication; mutation-lease-reconciliation; execute-resume-state | high ×3 |
| V · Verification/QA | verify-digest-gating; qa-private-store-fencing; review-smoke-session artifacts | critical, high, normal |
| W · Serving ephemera | web-operation-hub-shutdown-markers; controlled-runtime fencing wrapper; runtime-store hygiene | high, high, normal |
| C · Context tier | config-precedence; workspace-layout-gitpub | normal |

- **One file, two packages**: `runcontrol` and `productstate` hold independent pools on `.ultraplan/run-control.db`; productstate verifies no pragmas, never pings, has no Close/versioning.

- **Coverage void**: `productstate` is at 0.0% coverage with no test file, and all three DB-authoritative branches are unreachable from existing suites (no fixture creates the DB outside runcontrol's own tests).
- **Durability tiers classified**: `.stage-sessions.json` is the only atomic-rename write with no fsync; `summary.md`/`execute.md` are plain WriteFile; tasks.jsonl rewrites whole file per append, unbounded.
- **Shutdown semantics**: cleanup-uncertain markers written deliberately leaseless only after a 10s drain deadline, consumed fail-closed at next startup; single NotifyContext(INT,TERM) in main; TUI not ctx-torn-down.
- Verified frozen-delta at f73c4dc: 512 KiB prompt budget present; all spine claims spot-checked directly.

# map-02-state-authorities — State-Authority Surface Map (independent pass, rebound target)

Target: ultraplan-go @ `f73c4dc659ba1492c16382be26ffcbce1a5ea84a` (frozen; working tree clean). Workspace context: ultraplan-workspace @ `ab12dc38059c`. Method: five bounded review-worker discoveries (runcontrol SQLite; productstate/dual-home seam; study state family; sprint state authorities; ephemeral orchestration + config/gitpub) plus direct spot-checks of spine claims at the frozen SHA. Facts only; no findings. Lens: **durable and ephemeral state authorities, behaviours grouped by what they read/mutate.**

Repo frame: 17 packages (`go list ./...`), ~54k lines production Go (340 non-test files). Two packages open independent pools on the same SQLite file; three JSON state families (study `.ultraplan/run-state.json`, sprint `flow-state.json`, sprint `.run-state.json`) each exist in file AND DB form with runtime-selected authority. Frozen-delta check vs previously mapped SHA: only `internal/sprint/prompt_context.go` budget constant 256 KiB→512 KiB (verified present at line 20) and agentwrap dep bump — structural facts below are valid at `f73c4dc`.

---

## Part 1 — State-authority inventory (the spine)

### Durable authorities

**SA-1 · Run-control SQLite** — `<workspace>/.ultraplan/run-control.db`, owned by `internal/runcontrol` (`DatabaseRelativePath` sqlite.go:22). Dir created 0700 with symlink rejection (sqlite.go:154-166); DB file O_EXCL 0600, symlink/non-regular rejected (:171-186); modes re-enforced post-open (:193-205). Pool default 4 conns, operator-cappable 1..16 (sqlite.go:24-25,92-100). DSN pragmas `_busy_timeout=5000 _foreign_keys=on _journal_mode=WAL _synchronous=FULL _txlock=immediate _defensive=1` (:73-79); verifyPragmas reads back four of six — **`_txlock` and `_defensive` are set but never verified** (sqlite.go:207-227). Schema v1 in one DDL block `initialSchema` (sqlite.go:229-342): `app_schema`, `runs` (11 lifecycle states incl. `persistence_degraded`; record_state full/compacted/tombstone; terminal↔finished_at↔lifecycle table CHECK), `attempts` (fencing_generation>0, host_digest/boot_id/pid/process_birth_token, UNIQUE(run_id,ordinal)+UNIQUE(run_id,fencing_generation)), `events` (PK(run_id,sequence), 12-value event_type CHECK incl. omission), `operation_aliases` (columns expires_at/recovery_code/recovery_guidance exist but **no statement ever writes them**; rows cascade-delete with run), `reconciliation_log` (evidence_json ≤16KiB); trigger `trg_events_immutable` RAISE(ABORT) on UPDATE of events (:327-331); 9 indexes. Versioning dual-recorded (`app_schema('run_control',1)` :356 + `PRAGMA user_version=1` :359); read path uses user_version only, but app_schema row is verified equal on every open plus `PRAGMA integrity_check` (migration.go:236-266); version>1 rejected. Migration lock `<db>.migrate.lock` O_EXCL with JSON ProcessIdentity payload + Sync; stale reclaim requires exact birth-token mismatch proof — malformed/unvalidatable lock JSON never authorizes removal (migration.go:140-165). Backups only when version==0 with pre-existing foreign objects: WAL TRUNCATE checkpoint → byte copy `.bak.<stamp>` ≤512 MiB 0600, keep newest 3 (maxBackupBytes migration.go:20-23, prune :... (line truncated to 2000 chars)

**SA-1b · Lifecycle/fencing mechanics** — Fence `{RunID, AttemptID, OwnerID, FencingGeneration}` verified by join requiring owner+generation+`runs.current_attempt_id==attempt_id` (sqlite.go:985-1003). Claim: ordinal/generation = MAX+1 inside immediate tx; CAS `WHERE current_attempt_id IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL` (:544-592). Append: terminal-immutability gate; sequence = last_sequence+1; CAS on `(last_sequence, current_attempt_id, terminal_outcome IS NULL)` else CodeStaleFence (:608-711). ProposeTerminal: single-winner CAS, loser gets stale-fence (:722-807). Heartbeat = lease renewal via two CAS steps (lifecycle.go:14-68) — no HoldLease exists. Lease constants model.go:513-521: tick 1s, heartbeat 5s, lease 15s, reconcile 10s, grace 45s, batch 64/256. Cancellation: fence-free RequestCancellation CAS + fenced AcknowledgeCancellation CAS, both idempotent (lifecycle.go:91-181). Reconciliation decisions from process-birth probes: linux `/proc/<pid>/stat` starttime + boot_id (process_linux.go:16-45); darwin sysctl (process_darwin.go:13-39); other platforms HostDigest+PID only, always identity-unavailable (process_other.go). Decision matrix lifecycle.go:481-509: probe not-found→interrupted; uncertain/incomplete identity→cleanup_uncertain; birth mismatch→interrupted; exact match expired lease→mark_stalled; never-claimed-after-grace→interrupted. Evidence reduced to classes safe_identity_only/acceptance_timestamp_only, recorded to reconciliation_log (lifecycle.go:511-527). **Schema/model-valid values `LivenessOwnerUnreachable` (sqlite.go:246, model.go:60) and `CancellationUncertain` (counted at sqlite.go:877) have no code path that ever writes them.**

**SA-2 · Product-state SQLite (same file, second package)** — `internal/productstate/store.go` declares the identical const `DatabaseRelativePath = ".ultraplan/run-control.db"` (store.go:19, spot-checked) and opens an independent pool: same four core pragmas, **no `_defensive`, no PingContext, no pragma verification**, fixed MaxOpenConns(4), no SetMaxIdleConns (store.go:67-78). Own tables `product_states(kind,scope PK; header_json+header_hash)` and `product_state_items(PK(kind,scope,item_key), FK cascade, ordinal index)` created IF NOT EXISTS on every open (:92-116) — **no version tracking, no migration path beyond IF NOT EXISTS**. Handles cached process-lifetime in package-global `stores sync.Map` keyed by abs workspace root; LoadOrStore dedupe closes the loser; **no exported Close(), no Delete(), no eviction** (store.go:39,55-90). Save = single immediate tx: change-gated header upsert (unchanged headers do not bump updated_at), per-item hash-gated upsert, stale-item sweep (:150-206). Load = **two statements, not wrapped in a tx** (header then items, :127-148); sha256 hashes are written into *_hash columns but **never read back or verified anywhere**. Kinds registered by callers: `study_run` scope=study name (study/state_database.go:13,67), `sprint_flow`/`sprint_execute` scope=`<project>/<slug>` (sprint/state_database.go:13-17,96,126). Populated only by `ultraplan storage migrate` (app/storage_commands.go:60-206) or first Ensure()-backed save.

**SA-3 · Study run-state file** — `studies/<n>/.ultraplan/run-state.json` (domain.go:5-6; path builder run_state.go:188-190). `RunStateSchemaVersion=1`; load rejects version 0 as malformed, others unsupported; validation whitelist gates kind {analysis,synthesis}, 9 statuses, unique task IDs, session bounds SessionID≤512 chars / no CR-LF-NUL, per-task required fields (state.go:121-166). 64 MiB legacy-load threshold triggers content drop + runtime.GC (state.go:15,52-55). Diagnostics truncated to 4096 B on every load/save (durable_metadata.go:84-89). Write: clone+stamp→compact→validate→CreateTemp same dir→Sync→Close→optional BeforeRename hook→rename→syncDir; ignored errors: temp remove, close-on-error, and all syncDir errors (state.go:73-119,177-183). Reset archives prior state to `.ultraplan/archive/run-state-<ts>.json` (run_loop.go:567-572).

- Primary files/symbols: internal/web/{security,server,server_policy,routes,handlers,operation_handlers,operations,run_handlers,timeline_handlers,artifacts}.go; internal/app/markdown.go; app/web_usecases.go preview containment.

- Trust role: IN-11; CT-1 via same gateway.
- State: none beyond gateway.

---

## Seams between surfaces (producer ⇄ consumer)

1. Interface→gateway seam (S11/S12/S1 → S2): all mutating intents converge on AcceptOperation/beginDurableCLICommand; three different dedup-key derivations meet one alias table.
2. Service→validator seam (S3/S4): runtime adapter output → stage validators → promotion-or-fail; extraction tolerance precedes strict decoding by design.
3. Adapter→binary seam (S5 → S6): product-side policy stack composes SDK requests; session deletion crosses back into subprocess capability with interpolated-but-escaped SQL.
4. Manifest→runner seam (S4/S6): validated manifests become DirectRunner argv/env; drift detection closes the loop post-execution.
5. Save/load→authority seam (S8 → S10): atomic file writes vs conditional-upsert DB writes selected by file-existence predicate.
6. Journal seam (S2 → S9): controlledRuntime events pass the two-layer sanitizer before durable append; fencing quadruple binds events to claim generations.
7. Completion→publication seam (S3/S7): validated stage artifacts determine owned-path sets handed to gitpublish.
8. Containment substrate seam (S8 under all): every path-producing surface delegates to a package-local helper rather than one shared resolver — four distinct containment implementations coexist (workspace.ResolveInside lexical; sprint per-component Lstat; codeextract/web EvalSymlinks+Rel; runcontrol Lstat boundary).

## Domain grouping & suggested review order

- **A admission** (S1, S2): where intent becomes capability; S2 critical because it is the single chokepoint invariant (accept-before-execute) protecting every runtime-backed operation.
- **B agent trust transitions** (S3, S4, S5): highest volume of attacker-influenced bytes (model output, repo content) becoming durable state and verdicts; S5 additionally owns a deletion-capable SQL channel.
- **C external process & repo mutation** (S6, S7): capability grants to children and to git remotes; strong existing controls, asymmetric env handling worth one pass.
- **D persistence trust** (S8, S9, S10): corruptible/hostile disk state re-entering the program; S10 flagged high primarily due to zero test evidence across its branches, not observed misbehaviour.
- **E observation** (S11, S12): E1 is the only network boundary with layered defenses already heavily pinned; residual review focus on stream lifetimes and session-model assumptions.

Every runtime-backed operation (CLI sprint/study, TUI op, browser op) executes over a **two-tier durable spine**:

1. **Outer operation run** — created once per user command/op by `beginDurableCLICommand` (durable_operations.go:49) or the web/TUI `sharedOperationRunner` → `durableOperationManager.AcceptOperation` (:97): repo `Accept(Target.Kind:"operation", ProductStatus:"prepared", OperationAlias=digest)` → alias conflict → `ResolveOperationAlias` → `AcceptedOperation{Existing:true}` (:106-112) → `Claim(Lease=OwnerLeaseDuration)` → fenced `EventLifecycle/Running` append (failure ⇒ terminal `persistence_lost`, :121-128) → child ctx = `WithCancel(WithParentRun(ctx, RunID))` + ownership value → `go controlOperation` (:136).
2. **Inner runtime runs** — every agent call (`sprint.Service` stage/task/QA StartRun at runtime_metrics.go:120 / qa.go:556; study RunAnalysis/Synthesize) goes through `controlledRuntime.StartRun` (run_control.go:159): a **second** `Accept(ProductStatus:"accepted")` + `Claim` + fence, correlated to the outer run via `Correlation.ProductRunID = ParentRun(ctx)` (:161-164), metadata `run_control_run_id` injected into the agent request (:187). So one CLI flow command produces 1 outer run + N inner runs (one per stage/task/shard attempt).

Shared inner-run mechanics (verified verbatim at frozen SHA):
- Event path: wrapped `req.OnEvent` builds a sanitized draft, content-hash coalesces identical `progress` payloads within `ProgressCoalesceWindow=250ms` (model.go:13) into omission counters (:215-236); **delivery is persistence-gated**: the consumer's configured OnEvent fires only after a successful Append (:237-248); first Append failure sets `persistenceErr` and cancels the run ctx (:196-203).
- Control goroutine per run: 1s tick (`OwnerTickInterval`) polls Snapshot for cancellation requests (ack via fenced `AcknowledgeCancellation` then cancel); heartbeat every 5s renewing the 15s lease (`OwnerLeaseDuration`); `Reconcile` sweep every 10s (run_control.go:252-301; model.go:513-521).
- Terminal: trailing coalesced-omission flush under `eventMu` (:303-315); on persistErr → `TerminalPersistenceLost` proposal on detached 30s Background ctx (:322-332); else `terminalOutcome(result, runErr, ctx)` → `proposeRunTerminalWithRetry`: retries `ErrUnavailable|ErrBusy` every ~100ms until the 30s detached ctx expires (single-winner CAS inside runcontrol; losers get existing snapshot).
- Retry helpers: `appendRunEventWithRetry` 5s deadline, ≤100ms sleeps (:345-356); `waitRunControlRetry` caps sleeps at 100ms (:374-390).

# Surface Map — map-05-interface-surfaces (CLI / TUI / web interfaces)

Job: independent product-surface discovery from the interface lens. No findings reported in this phase; risk notes are prioritisation rationale only.

## Provenance

- Target: `/home/antonioborgerees/coding/ultraplan/ultraplan-go` frozen at `f73c4dc659ba1492c16382be26ffcbce1a5ea84a`. All discovery ran against a dedicated pinned clone (`/tmp/opencode/map05-frozen`, verified `git rev-parse` = `f73c4dc…`, clean). The live working tree sits at `8eef70f`; sole delta vs frozen is go.mod/go.sum (agentwrap dep bump) — no interface code changes, so every fact below holds for both.
- Planning workspace consulted read-only at `ab12dc38059c…`: `system/contracts/surfaces/{cli.md,api-contracts.md,frontend.md}` (CURRENT-CONTRACT anchors).
- Method: five parallel bounded `review-worker` discoveries (CLI grammar/dispatch, TUI end-to-end, web routes/projection/compat, web operations+security, cross-interface convergence) + mapper verification of the load-bearing claims directly at the pinned commit: empty CLI acceptance digest (`durable_operations.go:55`); TUI cancel decision tree and digest formula + `Confirmation != nil` gating (`internal/tui/app.go:107-141,232-238`); `validCommandOrigin` docstring-vs-body drift (`internal/web/security.go:269-298`); constant-time API CSRF vs plain `!=` form CSRF compare (`security.go:155`, `operation_handlers.go:294`); 27-entry OperationKind enum; error-text sniffing sites (`sprint_commands.go:269,360-364,507`); `orderRunArgs` semantics; skills help listing 9 stages vs workspace layer's 11 incl. `reconcile`/`code-context`; browser terminal→reload (`static/app.js:887-894`); rune-unaware truncation (`views.go:312-317`); web `readOnly:true` vs TUI default-false with `RefreshMayWrite` consequence (`web_usecases.go:429`, `usecases.go:68`, `sprint_usecases.go:389,455`); sprint-create outside token flow (`handlers.go:1312-1334`); QA-cancel ownership precheck only in `CancelQA` (`sprint_usecases.go:716-737`); no template/JS issuer of `study-cancel`; no TUI constructors of `validate`/`sprint-stage(-dry-run)`; 512-event/1s/250ms constants triplicated un-pinned.
- Baseline at freeze: go test / -race / vet / cover all passed (state.json).
- A stale pre-bind map previously existed here against target `f0fcd0c…`; this file replaces it.

## Interface topology in one paragraph

One binary, three frontends over one app core. `cmd/ultraplan/main.go` injects `TUIRunner`/`WebRunner` function types into `app.Run` (`internal/app/app.go:144-177`; inversion at `surfaces.go:18-20`); nothing in `internal/app` imports the frontends. One composition root resolves the workspace identically for all three (`discoverWorkspace`, `app.go:287-298`: global `--workspace[=…]` flag → `ULTRAPLAN_WORKSPACE` → cwd-ancestry walk to an `ultraplan.yml` marker), and one SQLite run-control repository per workspace (`.ultraplan/run-control.db`) backs observation, cancellation, and durable acceptance everywhere. CLI handlers mostly call product services directly; TUI and web both drive the shared `OperationalUseCases` boundary (`dashboardUseCases`) plus `DurableOperationManager` + `repositoryRunUseCases`, with runtime-backed work funnelling through one `sharedOperationRunner` (`operation_runner.go:15-166`). Divergence lives in grammar (five arg-parsing styles in the CLI alone), durability mechanics (CLI accepts with empty digest/no dedup vs web session-token dedup keys vs TUI content-derived digests), capability coverage (web-only sprint create/models/timeline/resources; CLI-only code/storage/diagnostics-export/study-reset; TUI-only parallelism form and fixed diagnostic rationale), and composition flags (web builds use cases `readOnly:true`; TUI leaves write-on-refresh enabled).

---

## Candidate surfaces

Grouping proposal: **A — CLI shell** (A1–A2), **B — Web console** (B1–B3), **C — TUI** (C1–C2), **D — Cross-interface convergence** (D1).

### A1 — `cli-dispatch-exit-contract` (domain A)
- Behaviour: argv dispatch of 15 top-level verbs (`--help/-h`, `version`, `init-workspace`, `defaults`, `skills`, `config`, `health`, `storage`, `run`, `project`, `sprint`, `study`, `tui`, `serve`, `code`); whole-argv global `--workspace` scan accepting both space and `=` forms (`app.go:198-220`); exit classes 0–8 with stable string codes (`validation.usage`, `config.invalid`, `provider.runtime`, `workflow.cancelled`, `workflow.partial`, …, `app.go:15-25,67-86`); three output regimes: stable `jsonEnvelope {schema_version,command,workspace,status,generated_at,result}` (`json_output.go:11-31`), ad-hoc sprint-family maps with rich QA error objects (`sprint_commands.go:108,455-459,1463-1492`), and raw structs (`metrics --json`, storage migrate, run-follow NDJSON, codeextract JSON).
- Files/symbols: `cmd/ultraplan/main.go`, `internal/app/{app,json_output,status_json,qa_errors}.go`, per-family `*_commands.go`; contract doc `docs/cli-reference.md`.
- Failure semantics: unknown command → exit 2 stderr (`app.go:175-177`); classified causes preserved via `classedError` (`app.go:41-86`); classification differs per family (run-control map → {2,5,8,6}; project → {4,5}; sprint generic → {4,5,6,7,8}; QA cancel/deadline → **8** while durable-run cancellation → **7**; study run-all partial → 8).
- Inventory facts: three `strings.Contains(err.Error(), …)` text-sniffing classifiers survive in flow/execute/review paths (`sprint_commands.go:269,360-364,507`) while the operation-runner path pins no-text-classification by test (`sprint_error_test.go:29-41`); five coexisting parser styles (stdlib flag + `orderRunArgs` reorderer where an unknown dash token becomes positional and a valued flag swallows the next token even if it is a flag, `run_commands.go:463-481`; hand loops; positional grammar switches; global pre-parser); `flag=value` support inconsistent across families; dash-leading values rejected in several hand parsers but accepted via `--workspace=-foo`; undocumented automation surface: `tui`, `storage migrate`, `sprint metrics`, `study runs summary`, model/variant override flags, `prompt --explain`, cancel reason whitelist beyond `user_requested`, `--workspace=` form; embedded skills help lists 9 stages while the workspace layer installs 11 incl. `reconcile` and `code-context` (`skills_commands.go:119-129` vs `workspace/skills.go:41,102`).
- Interactive prompts (no TTY detection anywhere): `defaults install` overwrite confirm, `skills materialise` confirm (EOF ⇒ answer-no, skip, exit 0), study run-loop `--reset` confirm (decline/EOF ⇒ exit 8) (`defaults_commands.go:125-144`, `skills_commands.go:148-167`, `study_commands.go:277-316`).
- Key tests: `app_test.go` (help/version/unknown/classified cause/redaction), `run_commands_test.go`, `sprint_commands_test.go` (21 tests: exit classes, single failure document, stable QA codes, deterministic status), `study_*_commands_test.go`, `serve_commands_test.go` (loopback-only listen matrix preflight), `code_commands_test.go` (exit 2/4/5/8 matrix), `qa_errors_test.go`.
- Seams: every runtime-backed verb crosses the durable acceptance seam (source-scanned by `TestEveryRuntimeBackedCLIEntryUsesDurableAcceptanceInventory`, `run_control_inventory_test.go:11-55`); stdout/stderr discipline (progress on stderr for sprint/study except durable run-loop progress on stdout) is part of the automation contract.

### A2 — `run-cli-observation-control` (domain A)
- Behaviour: `run list|show|follow|cancel|diagnostics` against the shared repository: filtered listing (limit default 50, bounds enforced downstream 1..200), snapshot render, follow loop (512-event batches, 1 s wait dropping to 250 ms when batch full or lagging; exits when terminal && cursor ≥ LastSequence; ctx-cancel stops observation only), cancel with reason whitelist {user_requested, operator_requested, shutdown_requested, quota_exceeded} → `RequestCancellation`, diagnostics health block + bounded support export (≤1 MiB, O_EXCL mode 0600).

- Key tests: `TestRunCommandsListShowFollowCancelDiagnosticsAndSupport`, `TestRunFollowReplaysTerminalJournalAndStopsWithoutCancelling`, `TestRunHelpDoesNotOpenRepository` (`run_commands_test.go`).
- Seams: same repository queries as web SSE replay and TUI polling; same `RequestCancellation` as all interfaces; opens the run-control DB (and runs startup Reconcile) even for reads.

1. **Durable acceptance ×3 mechanisms** — `beginDurableCLICommand` (empty digest, sync, no dedup) / web `startConfirmed` (token-derived dedup key, ErrWebUnavailable ephemeral fallback) / TUI `beginOperation` (canonical+fingerprint digest, gated on `Confirmation != nil`). 2. **Operation-kind vocabulary** — Go enum ↔ browser aliases (contract-tested) ↔ TUI typed constants (compile-time only) ↔ CLI durable Target kinds (inventory-scanned, not value-checked).
3. **Cancellation** — three doors into `RequestCancellation` with differing reason vocabularies and target validation; `study-cancel` SIGINT side channel bypasses the durable record entirely.
4. **Observation** — one repository; three projections (text/envelope NDJSON, {data,meta}+SSE, rendered TUI); replay constants triplicated; omissions/gaps surfaced differently per door.
5. **Workspace resolution** — single `discoverWorkspace` for all doors; `init-workspace`/`defaults`/`skills` bypass it; serve freezes identity at boot.
6. **Confirmation authority** — fingerprint is server-issued (caller-supplied values zeroed, rejected at decode, re-checked at execution); TUI/web honour it; CLI has no fingerprint concept at all.

1. **D1** cross-interface divergence — same-action-different-semantics class: acceptance digests/dedup asymmetry, readOnly write-on-refresh split, QA-precheck gap, unpinned enum literals.
2. **B2** operation hub/SSE — intent→durable-work conversion: token consume freshness, out-of-flow sprint create, drain/cleanup-uncertain honesty, terminal-reload inconsistency.
3. **B3** security controls — docstring/body origin drift, form-vs-API CSRF asymmetry, session expiry posture, dead helpers.
4. **IC2/C2** TUI lifecycle — study-cancel confirm bypass, silent emit drops, overloaded cancel key, fakes-vs-real-manager coverage gap.
5. **A1** CLI contract — exit-code text-sniffing inconsistencies, parser quirks, undocumented automation surface, prompt-on-non-TTY exits.
6. **B1/C1/A2** — normal-high: projection honesty (unfrozen raw DTOs, restart-invalidated refs, rune-unaware truncation, staleness windows, triplicated replay logic).

## Neutral inventory facts carried forward

- `validCommandOrigin` docstring vs strict-equality body; `validOrigin`/`validOperationReadOrigin`/`eventIDHeader` defined-but-unused.
- Cookie lacks `Secure`; no server-side session expiry (MaxAge browser-side only; HMAC valid until process restart rotates the secret).
- HTML `_csrf` uses `!=`; API header compare is constant-time; JS retries once on 403 adopting the rotated token.
- No per-session operation cap (global 8/32/32); slow subscribers silently disconnected.
- Sprint-create mutation sits outside the prepare/confirm/token machinery (session+origin+form-CSRF only).
- SSE terminal → full page reload (operations page) vs no reload (runs page); `op_*` ids → 410.
- Artifact preview refs die on process restart (in-process mint map required, not MAC alone).
- TUI: silent emit drops; success text in Error field; rune-unaware byte truncation; no idle poller; Esc-detach leaves study loops running; study-cancel skips durable acceptance; nav always sends resume-kind; parallelism default 3 (TUI) vs 1 (web) vs config (CLI).
- CLI: empty acceptance digest (dedup unreachable); three text-sniffing classifiers; QA cancel→8 vs run cancel→7; five parser styles with inconsistent `=`/dash-value handling; undocumented verbs/flags listed in A1; skills help omits `reconcile`/`code-context`; EOF on confirms = decline (skip=0, reset=8).
- Enum literals, digest formulas, and 512/1s/250ms polling constants are unpinned by any test; frontend.md contract describes a nonexistent frontend tree.
- Non-TTY TUI behaviour rests on bubbletea v1.3.10 internals (dependency-derived, not executed); packaging test is `-short`-skipped.

13: ## Interface topology in one paragraph

15: One binary, three frontends over one app core. `cmd/ultraplan/main.go` injects `TUIRunner`/`WebRunner` function types into `app.Run` (`internal/app/app.go:144-177`; inversion at `surfaces.go:18-20`); nothing in `internal/app` imports the frontends.
